title: TheEnderiteUpdate
description: This adds a new tier called Enderite! Same process as Netherite, but just better and in the end!
body:
This is a small mod (for now) that adds Enderite armor and tools! Currently Lost Debris is what you find in The End to get Enderite Scraps. Similar process to Netherite if you get what I mean. Currently The End doesn't generate Lost Debris so the armor and tools aren't available in survival just yet!


# **Enderite Armor:**
Full set! Has full knockback resistance and slightly higher stats than netherite!
All enchants can go one more higher! Example: Protection V (5) is max instead of IV (4)

## **Enderite Armor features:**
### - Ender Escape
When all armor is worn, you have a ability called Ender Escape. It gives you the Totem Of Undying buff. When killed you will teleport away at the cost of less health regained. There will be a 5 minute cooldown applied. 
### - Ender Totem
Uses Totem Of Undying without needing to hold or equip them. These take priority if held over Ender Escape.
### - End Power (Planned)
Any debuff that The End or end-related content can apply to a regular player will not apply to you. This will include ender pearl damage, end mites appearing, dragon's breath, levitation from a shulker, etc.
### - Full Knockback Resistance
Can't be knocked back at all!

# **Enderite Tools:**
Full set! Slightly higher stats than netherite! 
All enchants can go one more higher! Example: Protection V (5) is max instead of IV (4)
  
## **Enderite Tools features:**
Nothing added so far.
